# Dense geometry guide native reference

Original OPC/XML generated by `tools/canvas_dense_guides_fixture.py`, reusing
our original dense-path package. One adjustment and 32,768 dependent guides
control a rectangle: the final guide sets its width to 150pt in a 300pt frame.
No user artwork or third-party renderer is embedded.

The exact fixture was opened in the reference application and exported without
saving to native.pdf. The source SHA-256 and eleven ink cross-sections are recorded
by tools/dense_guides_reference.py. Browser checks compare the native reference ink within
0.75pt, assert resolved vertices, preserve all guides through text editing and
export/reopen, and compare every original ZIP entry after undo.

ECMA-376 Part 1 Annex A.4.1 CT_GeomGuideList permits unbounded gd children.
The removed 10,000-guide cutoff rejected this valid fixture. Existing formula,
reference and finite-number validation and package resource limits remain.
